name: Hawaiian
summary: **Hawaiian** is a [[kind:landrace|landrace]] [[label:sativa|sativa]] native to the Hawaiian Islands, grown there long before entering the US mainland cannabis trade in the 1960s and 1970s. It was later used as a parent in crosses such as [[northern-lights-5|Northern Lights #5]]. Some cannabis sold as Hawaiian today is a hybridized descendant rather than the original landrace.
